summary: The name is Orion (decision 0071: the skill folder, the package and the repository and Pages addresses moved; the old Pages address no longer works), the lean app bundle (0069), one accent job per screen (0068, 0070), validated dial values (0067), window controls and nothing re-wraps mid-motion (0072), the QA pass rules (0073, 0076), the upgrade path itself (0075), window controls in Line Duotone set evenly in the corner (0077, 0079), selecting several the desktop way (0078), a softer glass glow scaled to the surface (0080), and budgets proven on real requests with an app icon pack and an S4.theme that never fails silently (0081), a neutral Ink Track and a checker that counts accent selections (0082), tables at common widths with column priority, a scroll-edge cue and a full row ring (0083), a skip link in every app shell and F6 regions in desktop apps (0084), and quieter accent text (0085). No class, token, attribute or file was removed; four old motion names are now deprecated and renamed.

renames.note: skill/s4-orion/ is skill/orion/ and s4-orion.skill is orion.skill.
The old Pages address no longer works.
Old name, same function; kept as an alias until 1.3.0.

Panels pop; nothing slides from an edge. Same arguments. Kept as an alias until 1.3.0.

judgment.title: S4.transition.containerTransform is deprecated
judgment.what: containerTransform(surface, source, opts) only pops the surface now; call S4.transition.pop(surface, opts) (drop the source argument). The alias goes in 1.3.0.

judgment.title: Dial values are checked
judgment.what: S4.theme with a value off a dial's list warns and writes nothing, and the page checker fails a bad data-* dial value in markup. Use only the values in S4.theme.dials (no data-scale="roomy", no corners: 'square').

judgment.title: One accent job per screen
judgment.what: At rest a screen shows one filled action (the next act on the work in front of you) and one accent selection (the navigation's). Other buttons are elevated or text; the open row beside its detail is neutral (data-split-open does it); no pressed "All" chip (data-select="single" data-clearable). The page checker warns on a second filled action on the first screen.

judgment.title: A finished app loads the lean bundle
judgment.what: Prefer orion.core.min.css and .js plus only the packs the app uses (data, commands, desktop, direct, inputs, sitekit; core first). node <skill>/scripts/packs.mjs page.html lists them; the page checker fails a lean page that links too few or too many. Prototypes may keep orion.css and orion.js.

judgment.title: The product is called Orion
judgment.what: Say Orion, not S4 Orion, in the app's own words (about pages, credits, docs). The s4 prefix of classes, tokens and S4.* never changes.

judgment.title: Window controls are full cells
judgment.what: In a frameless Windows or Linux shell, .s4-window-control buttons are 46 wide, the bar's height, flush with the window's top and end edges; remove app CSS that sizes or spaces them. While anything changes size its contents keep their end layout (the checker freezes every motion at 25, 50 and 75%).

judgment.title: Place-holding containers ring only for the keyboard
judgment.what: A container that takes focus only to hold the place (tabindex="-1" on main, a view, a page, a dialog's box) rings only while <html data-s4-input="key">; never write a ring on :focus alone or rely on :focus-visible for it (WebKit draws it after a tap).

judgment.title: Copy with S4.util.copy
judgment.what: Replace navigator.clipboard.writeText with S4.util.copy(text, { done: 'Link copied' }): it never rejects and says when the browser refused. The page checker fails a direct writeText.

judgment.title: Trailing and meta text wraps
judgment.what: An app's own grid names its column (grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr)) and trailing, meta and status text wraps inside its row; it never truncates or widens the page. Check the app at 320 wide with 200% text.

judgment.title: Selecting several is one model
judgment.what: Tables with a select column, multi-select trees and listboxes and data-selectable lists take Shift, Ctrl and Ctrl+Shift clicks, Shift and Ctrl with the arrows, Home, End and Page keys, Space, Shift+Space, Ctrl+A and Escape by themselves. Remove app code that selects rows on its own (the page checker fails a multi-select collection the model does not drive). In a data table with a select column a mouse click now selects the row; make sure each row opens by a link or data-page-open in a cell (Enter and a double-click open it too). Read the selection with table.selection() or s4-change type 'select'.

judgment.title: Apps load the app icon pack
judgment.what: A lean page loads icons-app.js (copy it and icons-solar.js, which it fetches for any other name) instead of icons.js, which holds every set; keep icons.js only on a page that switches sets (S4.icon.use). The page checker fails a lean page that loads icons.js without switching. node <skill>/scripts/packs.mjs page.html names the file.

judgment.title: S4.theme warns on what it cannot use
judgment.what: A seed that is not #rrggbb or an accent name, a surfaces value other than neutral or tinted, and a key S4.theme does not know (accent, icons) now warn in the console and write nothing. density, buttons, cards, lists and rail are keys now (S4.theme.keys lists them). Open the app with the console showing and fix any S4: theme warning.

judgment.title: The Ink Track's selection is neutral
judgment.what: A connected button group's selected option is now on-surface over the track, not the accent. If the app painted the ink itself (--_ink) or relied on an accent segmented control to stand out, look at the screen again; the page checker warns on more than one accent selection at rest.

judgment.title: Data tables at common widths
judgment.what: Give a data table's least needed columns th[data-priority="1…5"] (never the column a person scans) so they fold away at narrower widths; a sideways-scrolling table now shows a fade on the side with more, and a focused row's ring is drawn by its cells (drop app CSS that outlined table rows).

judgment.title: App shells write their own skip link
judgment.what: app.js puts a Skip to Content link first in every app shell's page; an app that wrote its own .s4-skip-link keeps it. Drop app code that bound F6 in a desktop app (desktop.js does it).

judgment.title: The app knows its Orion version
judgment.what: Every page that loads Orion carries <meta name="orion" content="<version>"> and the app keeps orion.json at its root (upgrade.mjs writes both). core.js warns, and the page checker fails, when the stamp and the loaded files disagree.
